title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Incidentals, Multiple Rooms and Night Credit per Night
content:
**Ashbury Rewards — earning terms for incidentals and multiple rooms.** These terms set, for every tier, which folio charges besides the room count as eligible spend, whether the elite bonus also reaches points from those charges, how many rooms of one member earn at one hotel, and how many elite night credits a night stayed in one room is worth.

## Terms by tier

| Term | Member | Silver Elite | Gold Elite | Platinum Elite | Titanium Elite | Ambassador Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eligible incidental charges on the folio earn base points | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The elite bonus also applies to points from incidentals | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Folio charge codes besides room that count as eligible spend | breakfast; food and beverage; spa | breakfast; food and beverage; spa | breakfast; food and beverage; spa | breakfast; food and beverage; spa | breakfast; food and beverage; spa | breakfast; food and beverage; spa |
| Maximum rooms of the same member with overlapping nights at one hotel that earn points | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Maximum rooms of the same member with overlapping nights at one hotel that earn elite night credits | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Elite night credits per night stayed in one room | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

The tiers are written in the table by their elite names; the first column is the base tier, Ashbury Rewards Member.

## Reading the terms

- **Incidentals.** Three folio charge codes count as eligible spend besides room: breakfast, food and beverage, and spa. No other incidental code is named in these terms.
- **Rooms.** When one member holds several rooms with overlapping nights at one hotel, up to 3 of those rooms earn points, and only 1 of them earns elite night credits.
- **Nights.** One night stayed in one room is worth 1 elite night credit at every tier.

## Illustration (hypothetical booking)

A member holds four rooms at one Ashbury Hotel for the same two nights. Up to 3 of the rooms earn points; 1 room earns elite night credits, worth 1 credit for each of its two nights stayed.
